assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness
The symptoms have persisted despite initial management for known sick sinus syndrome
The condition is coded R42 for dizziness
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is indicated
The 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is coded CPT 93226
The appeal addresses the denial under Reason Code PR-204
The service is medically necessary to correlate the patient's symptoms with arrhythmic activity
